entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petition under section 439, Cr.P.C. has been file by the present petitioner who is in jail custody in connection with Bhanjanagar P.S. Case No. 57 of 2023 corresponding to G.R.Case No. 14 of 2023,
pending in the file of learned Addl. District Judge-cum-Special Court, under POCSO Act, Behampur for commission of alleged offences under sections 341/506/376-D of I.P.C. r/w Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

Since the earlier petition BLAPL No. 8469 of 2023 filed by the co-accused was rejected by this Bench by order dated 16.10.2023, the present petition has been listed before this Bench for consideration in terms of the Standing Order No.2 of 2023 dated 21.05.2023 of the High Court of Orissa.
2. Learned counsel for petitioner seeks to withdraw the petition and files the memo to that effect.
3. The petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
(M.S.Sahoo) Judge dutta Purna Chandra Swain @ Punia vs State Of Odisha ....
